plain_statement: Every vertex outside A has exactly three neighbours, A meets no edge, every cycle has length at least 7, there is an edge, f is true when an input of A is on or both ends of an edge are; C is a least AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit for f in which every vertex outside A is read by two or three gates (a NOT only at its first input), all OR gates when three.
